terms.label: Term 1
terms.focus: Orientation, diagnostics, routines, foundations, and first projects.
milestones: Complete student profile and access settings
Choose Foundation, Core, or Extended support by subject
Begin a reading and research portfolio

terms.label: Term 2
terms.focus: Core skill development, source literacy, practical application, and revision.
milestones: Complete a research-supported essay or presentation
Add two artifacts to the student portfolio

terms.label: Term 3
terms.focus: Deeper application, collaboration, creative production, and career exploration.
milestones: Complete a community, environment, or civic project
Create an arts, music, media, or technology artifact
Explore two career or further-study pathways
Revise the year plan using mastery evidence

terms.label: Term 4
terms.focus: Integration, capstone work, reflection, portfolio review, and Grade 10 preparation.

weekly_rhythm.focus: Application, laboratory, studio, or project work
Mastery check, reflection, revision, and portfolio
